name: @textfilters/profanity-en
description: Plain English deny and allow dictionary data for @textfilters/profanity.

scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run tests
scripts.smoke:dist: npm run build && node --input-type=module --eval "const { default: dictionary } = await import('./dist/index.js'); if (dictionary.id !== 'en') throw new Error('Invalid dictionary');"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && node ../../scripts/build-profanity-dictionary.mjs --check packages/profanity-en && npm run smoke:dist && npm run pack:dry-run
